sloka: अब्रवीच्च हरिश्रेष्ठः सीतामप्रतिजल्पतीम् ।किं नु चिन्तयसे देवि किं नु मां नाभिभाषसे ।। ६.११६.१६ ।।
transliteration: abravīcca hariśreṣṭhaḥ sītāmapratijalpatīm ।kiṁ nu cintayase devi kiṁ nu māṁ nābhibhāṣase ।। 6.116.16 ।।

translations.english: When Hanuman spoke in that way virtuous Sita was overwhelmed with joy and spoke with a voice choked with tears.
